title: Library Drift Check
summary: Flags registered library roots that have source on disk but nothing in the index

surfaces.path: drag-lint > Index & Maintenance > Library Drift Check...

surfaces.usage:
drag-lint library-drift [--platform

] [--config ] [--json] - registry library roots that have source on disk but none in the index (exit 2 if drift; roots the section exclude prunes are listed as excluded, not counted)
